name: PSM Multi Currency Switcher & Currency Converter for WooCommerce
author: PSM Plugins

sections.description:
Unlock Global Sales with the #1 Multi Currency & Currency Converter for WooCommerce

Stop losing international customers to currency confusion. PSM Multi Currency for WooCommerce is the leading feature-rich and easy-to-use plugin that allows your customers to browse products and pay for orders in their preferred currency. By providing accurate, real-time price conversions and dynamic exchange rates, you build immediate trust, reduce cart abandonment, and significantly boost your global WooCommerce sales.

Our powerful and intuitive currency switcher integrates beautifully with your WooCommerce store, offering a seamless multi currency experience from the first click to the final checkout. Whether you run a dropshipping business, a digital marketplace, or a large international store, this plugin provides the essential tools to go global with its robust multi currency capabilities and built-in currency converter. Enable customers to shop in their local currency and provide a truly global shopping experience.

Built by the trusted team behind the popular SupportCandy helpdesk plugin, PSM Multi Currency is designed for performance, compatibility, and rock-solid reliability, making it the ideal multi currency solution for WooCommerce.

Product Tour

Features

Our free version is packed with powerful features to give you maximum control over your store’s multi currency options:

  • Unlimited Currencies: Add and manage as many currencies as your business needs with this comprehensive currency converter. There are no limits to your WooCommerce multi currency setup.
  • Flexible Currency Switcher: Display a clean and fully customizable currency switcher anywhere on your website using our dedicated Gutenberg block, Elementor widget, or a versatile shortcode. This is key for your WooCommerce currency switcher functionality.
  • Seamless Multi Currency Checkout: Customers can browse, add to cart, and pay entirely in their chosen currency—ensuring a smooth, localized experience that increases trust and conversion rates with our multi currency system. This is a true multi currency checkout.
  • Enforce Checkout Currency Rules: Restrict which currencies are available for payment at checkout, regardless of the currency used for Browse—ensuring compliance and a smooth payment process with your WooCommerce currency converter.
  • Payment Gateway Control by Currency: Choose which payment gateways are available for each currency—giving you full control and ensuring customers only see compatible payment options. By default, all gateways are enabled for your multi currency setup.
  • Live & Manual Exchange Rates: Instantly refresh all currency rates with one click using Yahoo Finance, or set fixed custom exchange rates for each currency to suit your business needs. This ensures your currency converter is always accurate.
  • Conversion Fees: Add a fixed or percentage-based fee to converted prices—ideal for covering payment gateway costs or protecting your margins in your multi currency transactions.
  • Smart Rounding Rules: Customize how converted prices are rounded—choose to round up, down, or to the nearest value (e.g., 182.46 becomes 190 when rounding up to the nearest 10)—for cleaner, more consistent pricing with your WooCommerce currency converter.
  • WooCommerce Analytics Integration: All orders are accurately tracked in their original currencies, enabling you to view detailed sales reports and order data by currency within WooCommerce Analytics, perfect for multi currency sales analysis.

Pro Features

Unlock even more powerful tools with the Pro version for your WooCommerce multi currency solution:

  • Auto-Detect Currency by Country: Instantly display the correct currency for each visitor using advanced Geo IP detection. This enhances the currency converter experience and provides a truly localized shop currency view.
  • Customizable Exchange Rate Updates: Set your own schedule for automatic exchange rate refreshes—stay up to date without lifting a finger.
  • Multiple Exchange Rate Providers: Choose from a variety of reliable exchange rate APIs to best suit your business needs for your multi currency store.
  • Force Currency by Customer Location: Automatically enforce payment currency based on the customer’s billing or shipping country at checkout for compliance and convenience, leveraging the power of this currency switcher.

Learn more about the Pro version and upgrade here.

Compatibility

PSM Multi Currency for WooCommerce is built to be highly compatible with the WooCommerce ecosystem and works seamlessly with most themes and popular plugins, ensuring your currency converter functions flawlessly, including:

  • WooCommerce Subscriptions
  • Stripe and PayPal Payments
  • WPML (WordPress Multilingual Plugin)
  • WooCommerce Product Add-ons, Bundles, and One Page Checkout
  • Table Rate Shipping and Per Product Shipping
  • And many more…

External Services

This plugin connects to Yahoo Finance to fetch live exchange rates, which are securely stored in your database and used for real-time price conversions.

  • Service: Yahoo Finance
  • Purpose: Retrieving up-to-date exchange rates for accurate currency conversion.
  • Data Sent: Only the currency symbols for the base and target currencies (e.g., USD to EUR) are transmitted.
  • Frequency: When you add a new currency, update currency settings, or manually refresh exchange rates.
  • Terms: https://legal.yahoo.com/us/en/yahoo/terms/otos/index.html
  • Privacy Policy: https://legal.yahoo.com/us/en/yahoo/privacy/index.html

No personal or sensitive information is ever sent—only public financial data is accessed for conversion calculations.
sections.installation:
Installing the plugin is simple:

1. From Your WordPress Dashboard (Recommended)

  1. Navigate to Plugins > Add New.
  2. In the search bar, type “PSM Multi Currency for WooCommerce“.
  3. Find the plugin and click Install Now.
  4. Once installed, click Activate.
  5. Find the plugin settings under the PSM Plugins menu to begin configuration.

2. Manual Upload

  1. Download the plugin’s .zip file from this page.
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard and click the Upload Plugin button.
  3. Select the .zip file you just downloaded and click Install Now.
  4. Activate the plugin.
  5. Find the plugin settings under the PSM Plugins menu to begin configuration.

For a detailed setup guide, please see our documentation.
sections.faq:
How are the exchange rates updated?

The plugin fetches live exchange rates from Yahoo Finance. You can schedule automatic updates or enter custom exchange rates manually.

Can my customers truly pay in different currencies?

Yes. Our plugin supports a full multi currency checkout process. The currency a customer selects is the currency they will see on the cart, checkout page, and pay with through your payment gateway.

Will this work with my payment gateway (Stripe, PayPal, etc.)?

PSM Multi Currency is compatible with all major payment gateways that support multi currency transactions. If a specific gateway does not support multiple currencies, it may default to processing the payment in your store’s base currency, but the plugin will still display the converted price to the customer.
